name.zh: 喙嘴翼龙（R. muensteri 启发形态）

description.en: Rhamphorhynchus muensteri-inspired static gliding reconstruction with a long tail and tail vane. Membrane shape, soft tissues and pose are interpretive; the floor datum is presentation-only, not a flight-height or ground-contact claim.
description.zh: 喙嘴翼龙 Rhamphorhynchus muensteri 启发的静态滑翔复原，具长尾和尾叶。翼膜、软组织与姿态为推断；底部基准仅用于展示，不代表飞行高度或接地。
